rejected_before_model.commons_file: HK TKO 寶琳 Po Lam MCP 新都城中心 Metro City Plaza residential building entrance May 2022 Px3.jpg
rejected_before_model.reason: The visible entrance is explicitly signed The Metropolis / 都會豪庭, while the frozen target reference was Metro City Plaza. Treating it as a correct target-to-portal pair would create identity-label contamination.

portal_set_truth.definition: One current-view pedestrian glass-door bank or functional aperture belonging to the visibly named entity. Adjacent leaves and fixed glass panels form one functional portal set.
portal_set_truth.membership_rule: Candidate center is inside the frozen portal-set region and at least half of candidate area lies inside it.

laguna-plaza.kind: Laguna Plaza signed multi-leaf glass entrance

reference_audit.laguna-plaza: Different interior view contains Laguna Plaza wall identity and circulation context.
reference_audit.infinitus-plaza: Different exterior night view contains the Infinitus facade name and architectural skin.

claim_boundary: The audit establishes curated current-image target portal regions and public reference relevance only; not access, traversability, active motion, navigation, arrival, benefit, or safety.
